products.name: Cerrado Natural
products.about: Dried in the whole cherry on the high plateau of Minas Gerais, Brazil. Our darkest roast: nutty, chocolatey and low in acidity.

products.name: Yirgacheffe Konga
products.about: Grown by smallholders around Konga in Yirgacheffe, where the coffee is washed and dried on raised beds. A light roast keeps it floral and tea-like.

products.name: Nyeri Gatomboya
products.about: From the Gatomboya washing station in Nyeri, on the slopes of Mount Kenya. Kenyan coffee at its brightest: juicy, with a long, sweet finish.

products.name: Huila La Plata
products.about: From smallholder farms around La Plata in southern Colombia. A medium roast for a round, sweet cup that works as espresso and as filter.

products.name: Huehuetenango
products.about: Grown high in the western highlands of Guatemala, near the Mexican border. Chocolate and stone fruit, easy every morning.

products.name: Sugarcane Decaf
products.about: Colombian coffee decaffeinated with ethyl acetate made from sugarcane, a gentle process that keeps its sweetness. All of the flavour, none of the late-night buzz.
